themes.label: Great opportunities, risk of sinister misuse
themes.definition: AI and cutting-edge technologies framed as transforming human life with great opportunities but also risks of misuse for sinister purposes.
themes.inclusion: Include brief statements pairing AI's transformative opportunities with misuse risks.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages specifying concrete military AI or governance proposals.
themes.boundary_cases: A generic duality statement followed by a call for a strengthened UN stays here unless specific AI governance is proposed.

examples.quote: Artificial intelligence and other new cutting-edge technology are transforming every domain of human life, offering great opportunities, but at the same time, they also carry risks of being misused for sinister purposes.

value.rationale: Single DPRK passage dominated by nuclear-status assertions; AI appears in one generic sentence of opportunity-versus-misuse duality, followed by a general call for a stronger UN, with no specific AI policy.
